note: Round 147: the inner world. A pocket of your own that opens with the swarm and grows with sitting, tending and use. Nothing here is for sale; every gain is time-gated and capped per day so it stays a pastime.

levels.name: A Seed of Space
levels.text: A breath-wide room behind the eyes. A little earth, a little light.

levels.name: A Courtyard
levels.text: Walls of mist, a floor of packed earth. The beasts at rest have somewhere to lie.

levels.name: A Valley
levels.text: A bowl of green with a practice ring at its heart.

levels.name: A Vale of Streams
levels.text: Water finds its own way here. A still pool reflects more than the sky.

levels.name: A Small Heaven
levels.text: Weather of your own. The air tastes of qi.

levels.name: A Living Realm
levels.text: Things grow here that you did not plant.

levels.name: A Realm of Seasons
levels.text: It keeps its own year, and keeps it well.

levels.name: A Hidden World
levels.text: A horizon you have never walked to.

text.seed: The Reliable Seed: two more levels, a plot, two more beasts housed.
text.breath: The Hearth-Fire Breath: one more level, and the dao pool runs a quarter faster.
text.eye: The Gatherer's Eye: one more level, and every plot yields one more.
text.hands: The Steady Hands Method: one more level, and the practice ground takes 25 more minutes a day.
text.step: The Wayfinder's Step: one more beast can be housed.
text.heaven: The World-Seed: the last level, and every gift half again stronger.
